blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Companies entering mergers and acquisitions must notify the Philippine Competition Commission (PCC) within 30 days of signing their agreements, as the pandemic-related rule suspension has ended. The antitrust watchdog is reinstating a 30-calendar-day notification period for transactions that meet certain thresholds requiring mandatory merger review under Memorandum Circular No. 26-004.
